description: Check whether a secret you created has been opened yet, without consuming it. Returns { status, expiresAt, readAt? } where status is pending (not opened), read, burned or expired. Use it to confirm delivery, or before deciding to ncrypted_burn a link. Only works for secrets you created (needs their receiptToken); to open a link, use ncrypted_read. Free.

id.description: The secret's id, returned as `id` by ncrypted_create.

receiptToken.description: The creator's receipt token, returned as `receiptToken` by ncrypted_create. Only the creator has it; the link alone isn't enough.

name: ncrypted_status
title: Check one-time secret status
